title: Model bounded European dynamic raw transfer fragments
changes: Add a strict lossless source model for six selector rows and five bounded dynamic raw transfer bank prefixes without creating a runtime owner or guest index cap.
validation: One core-only Windows build from the retained runtime snapshot and one focused Wine test pass exact reconstruction and per-byte lookup of 1304 EUR source bytes, seven boundaries, JSON roundtrip, shape rejection and source/ROM authentication rejection; protected inputs unchanged.
Initial preparation stopped before compilation on an overly narrow inverse guard; the guard was corrected and the first actual build and test passed.
limitations: Source-only model; original transfer execution, managed extraction, native reads, actual CLI and ordinary dynamic use remain unverified. Other indices and global producer domain remain open.
New Linux, USA and native Windows checks remain pending. No performance measurement or old proof replay.
